common.unique_theta: one future compliant unique endpoint with original provenance; never choose from intermediate losses
common.frozen_inputs: original TRAIN populations, metadata, noise law, feature scales, region masses, directions and model numerical mode
common.bootstrap: 1000 paired macro-group resamples, 95 percent interval; no adaptive extension
common.tolerance_status: tau_D and tau_q must be registered from independent artificial checks before any new scientific results; not selected by this memo
common.forbidden_inference: A-F success, gradient bias improvement, new acquisition generalization or physical mapping identification

H1.hypothesis: A mean of one-noise-per-parent complete D values has a numerically resolved positive Jensen gap relative to pooling K independent noise occurrences per parent.
H1.priority: first diagnostic to consider after original R65 resolution; no automatic activation
H1.measure: every pooled SOURCE occurrence has global mass 1/(K*6593); within-region mass 1/(K*N_SOURCE_region); original outer masses fixed
H1.mathematical_property: Delta_m >= 0 in exact arithmetic for fixed directions, scales, REAL and these five D definitions, including monotone RMS of nonnegative coordinate W1
pass: 95 percent interval lower endpoint for mean Delta > tau_D
stop: any Delta_m < -tau_D: retain implementation/numerical failure, do not interpret science
otherwise unresolved interval: report not resolved and do not loosen tolerance or extend sampling
H1.does_not_estimate: true integrated-noise gradient, population uncertainty or independent-acquisition response

H2.hypothesis: A change of D-C coupling with preserved D and C marginals changes the raw combined-gradient second-moment trace by a numerically resolvable amount.
H2.pairing: same fixed theta, directions, all C IDs and per-occurrence noise, unchanged identity noise; independent D field shared for untouched parents
H2.independent_arm: original R65 independent full SOURCE epsilon
H2.coupled_arm: for each distinct SOURCE parent in C, replace only its one D white-noise row by the first occurrence's original independent C white-noise row; retain every C occurrence untouched
H2.marginal_proof: Conditional on C parent IDs, distinct parents choose distinct first occurrence slots; selected C noises and all unselected D noises are independent with the same original distribution. Therefore the D full-field marginal remains iid under the registered independent-stream model, and C is unchanged.
H2.primary_interpretation: E[q] equals change in E[||g_D+g_C||^2] because D and C marginal second moments are preserved
pass: C parameter gradient bitwise equal and original full D replay checks passed
stop: any mechanical/marginal/replay failure: stop and retain failure
unresolved interval: report not resolved; no claim of equality of all coordinate covariances or updates
descriptive_secondary: one shadow Adam update from an identical hash-bound theta-synchronous optimizer state, if available
H2.limitation: neither sign is automatically beneficial; this is not a reconstruction of original R63 coupling or an isolation of entire R63-R65 trajectory effects
